quantifiers: For each eta>0, eventually real alpha, GoodCoefficient alpha B(alpha,eta); equivalently thereafter each fixed alpha has an existential delta>0 and an eventual x threshold. The latter may depend on alpha,eta.
domains: mesh>=1 for every real alpha; log decomposition used only on eventual alpha>0; radius>=1, so every logarithm denominator is guarded. No issue is inferred from totalized values outside these uses.
